lastCompletedStory.title: Add devcontainer.json wiring the image, firewall, and non-root user

openQuestions: AC4 oracle uses grep -Eq with a negative lookahead (?!root) which macOS BSD grep/ugrep does not support in ERE mode. The implementation is correct (remoteUser is 'bun', not root); the oracle needs to be verified on the CI environment (macos-latest) or use grep -P for the check.
nextStoryContext: US-003 added .devcontainer/devcontainer.json. The file uses strict JSON (no comments), references the local Dockerfile via build.dockerfile, grants NET_ADMIN+NET_RAW in runArgs, sets remoteUser to 'bun' (matching the Dockerfile USER bun, from oven/bun:1.2-slim base), mounts a named volume 'claude-code-config' at /home/bun/.claude, sets DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 in containerEnv, and runs postStartCommand 'sudo bash /workspace/.devcontainer/init-firewall.sh'. No .ssh mounts. Note: the bun user (from the oven/bun:1.2-slim base) has home dir /home/bun, NOT /home/node as the reference devcontainer.json uses. All quality gates green (2290 pass / 0 fail). Next story is US-004 (Docker preflight helper).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Official docs confirm: runArgs for NET_ADMIN+NET_RAW, remoteUser non-root, named volume for ~/.claude (reference uses source=claude-code-config-${devcontainerId},target=/home/node/.claude,type=volume), containerEnv for DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER+CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC, postStartCommand for firewall init. Our implementation uses 'bun' user (not 'node') matching the oven/bun:1.2-slim base image USER directive. Reference uses /home/node; we use /home/bun.
